method: Live Node ownership and known widget-field identity. No numeric-text heuristics, no exclusions, and no drawing replacements. Every raw visible text node has exactly one category; each category sum equals the unchanged raw count.

definitions.unit_stats: Attack/Health labels owned by a CardView, CardDetail, or Nest Egg stat field.
definitions.hero_health: Health labels inside the LobbyPlaque Health badge; opponent tier is Other.
definitions.fallback_names: Tile name labels whose unit lacks its own portrait; no shipped exceptions remain.
definitions.costs_and_controls: Known card/item price fields, hero-power prices, gold and queued-income amounts, and rendered action-button text/cost descendants.
definitions.other: Every remaining visible text node, including tiers, Ring stacks, Belly/Hex counters, Midsummer, away text, turn labels, and reader identity/rules text.

reader_policy: Reader-open rows include all reader nodes and are reported outside the resting 40-node gate. Reader stat beads remain Unit stats; reader name, type, rules and reminders are Other; action buttons remain Costs and controls.
baseline_policy: Historical before/after manifests are preserved. Their earlier raw totals remain valid, but they lack live ownership metadata and are not retroactively classified by guessing from text or generated node paths.
